queries:
WITH status_means AS (
  SELECT
    sites.healtheval,
    AVG(scans.gbsize / NULLIF(scans.spanmin, 0)) AS mean_rate,
    AVG(scans.scancount) AS mean_scancount
  FROM scans
  JOIN sites ON sites.zoneregistry = scans.zoneref
  GROUP BY sites.healtheval
),
overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(mean_rate) AS all_status_mean
  FROM status_means
)
SELECT
  AVG(status_means.mean_rate),
  AVG(status_means.mean_scancount),
  AVG(status_means.mean_rate - overall.all_status_mean)
FROM status_means
CROSS JOIN overall
WHERE status_means.mean_rate > overall.all_status_mean

WITH matched_scans AS (
    SELECT
        si.presstat AS status,
        sc.scancount,
        1.0 * sc.scancount / sc.spanmin AS scan_rate
    FROM scans AS sc
    JOIN sites AS si ON si.zoneregistry = sc.zoneref
    WHERE si.presstat IS NOT NULL
      AND sc.scancount IS NOT NULL
      AND sc.spanmin > 0
),
status_rates AS (
    SELECT
        status,
        AVG(scan_rate) AS mean_rate,
        AVG(scancount) AS mean_scancount,
        COUNT(*) AS scan_count
    FROM matched_scans
    GROUP BY status
),
overall_rate AS (
    SELECT SUM(mean_rate * scan_count) / SUM(scan_count) AS mean_rate
    FROM status_rates
)
SELECT
    AVG(sr.mean_rate) AS mean_qualifying_status_rate,
    AVG(sr.mean_scancount) AS mean_qualifying_status_scancount,
    AVG(sr.mean_rate - o.mean_rate) AS mean_excess_rate
FROM status_rates AS sr
CROSS JOIN overall_rate AS o
WHERE sr.mean_rate > o.mean_rate
